notes: First provider of the `decide` inference type. Tier 3 rather than the Tier-2 catalog because the catalog schema pins `tier: z.literal(2)`, accepts only an 8-flag text-generation capability vocabulary with no `decide`, and requires `defaultMaxOutputTokens` / `pricingPerMTok.output` — none of which a model that emits no text can honestly supply. Declares `inferenceKinds: ["decide"]`, which keeps it out of auto-select, the health sweep and every generation fallback chain.
